summary: 29-year-old Loveland man went missing kayaking on Carter Lake on 2021-04-11; overturned kayak found near The Saddle boat launch ~2pm, his dog found alive nearby in flotation device. Five-day multi-agency search (12 agencies incl. LCSAR, ~700 personnel hours; drones, dogs, divers, sonar, ROV) ended 4/15; presumed dead, body not recovered.
location: Carter Lake (The Saddle boat launch, southern shore), southwest of Loveland
notes: Incident date from multiple contemporaneous reports (kayak found overturned ~2pm Sun 4/11/2021; search 4/11-4/15, suspended per LCSAR post 4/16). LCSAR was among 12 responding agencies (LCSO release via TSM). 29yo Loveland man presumed dead; body never recovered (search became recovery mission). Victim unnamed in sources (identity withheld). Standalone source: LCSAR post (real org).
